test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: 24 women and 9 men can complete piece of work in 18 days. Each women takes twice the amount of time taken by a man to finish the work. In how many days can only 9 men finish the same work?
solution:
Given:

24W + 9M = 18 days

W = 2M

Formula used:

Time = 1/Efficiency

Solution:

Efficiency of W = M/2

Total work = (24W + 9M) × 18

9 men can finish the work is given by:

⇒ ((24W + 9M) × 18)/9M

⇒ ((24(M/2) + 9M) × 18)/9M

⇒ ((12M + 9M) × 18)/9M

⇒ (21) x 2 

⇒ 42

Hence, the correct option is 1.
